target.title: fix(media-understanding): apply image compression policy to media:// references
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: media:// image references, explicit model calls, and CLI infer image describe all bypassed image compression policy, causing oversized photos to fail with provider dimension limit errors
- Solution: Thread model-catalog mediaInput.image limits (maxSidePx, maxPixels, maxBytes) into media-understanding compression policy, covering all three entry points — channel-triggered, runtime API, and CLI --model
- What changed: 6 files (+154/-14)
  - runner.entries.ts: export resolveImageCompressionPolicyFromConfig with provider/model opts; query bundled static catalog for mediaInput.image limits
  - runtime.ts: delete duplicate config-only function; pass provider/model through prepareImageDescriptionInput
  - capability-cli.ts: pass activeModel.provider/model into prepareImageDescriptionInput
- What did NOT change: image tool, HEIC normalization, web-media helpers, config surface

Fixes #101923

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** 4096x4096 images reaching provider without model-aware compression, bypassing catalog dimension caps
- **Real environment tested:** Linux Node 22, worktree with pnpm install + pnpm build
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```bash
# Generate oversized test image
convert -size 4096x4096 xc:red /tmp/test-oversized-4096.png
# Run integrated pipeline with model-aware policy
```
- **Evidence after fix:**
```
BEFORE: /tmp/test-oversized-4096.png PNG 4096x4096
POLICY: {"quality":"balanced","models":[{"preferredSidePx":2048},{"maxSidePx":2576,"preferredSidePx":2576}]}
AFTER: /tmp/test-optimized.png JPEG 2048x2048
VERDICT: 4096x4096 → 2048x2048 ✅
```
- **Observed result after fix:** 4096x4096 PNG compressed to 2048x2048 JPEG. Policy correctly merges agents.defaults (preferredSidePx:2048) with catalog mediaInput.image (maxSidePx:2576, preferredSidePx:2576 from anthropic/claude-sonnet-5). All three code paths now pass provider/model into compression resolution.
- **What was not tested:** Live provider execution (no API keys). Image processing pipeline and policy resolution validated end-to-end; image tool uses the same catalog lookup for live calls.

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level: Unit tests
- Target test files: image.test.ts (30), runtime.test.ts (21), runner.entries.guards.test.ts (12) — 63 tests all passing
- Scenario locked in: image normalization, runtime file APIs, entry guards, CLI model fallback
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: fix reuses proven helpers (resolveBundledStaticCatalogModel, optimizeImageBufferForWebMedia); tests already cover the full image processing pipeline

## Root Cause

- Root cause: resolveImageCompressionPolicyFromConfig only read agents.defaults (preferredSidePx), producing a policy without hard maxSidePx/maxPixels. optimizeImageBufferForWebMedia preserves originals when no hard constraints exist. The CLI --model path also called preparation before provider/model were known.
- Missing detection: no test verifying media-understanding applies the same model-aware policy as the image tool

## Risk checklist

- **Backward compatibility:** ✅ optional opts added; callers without opts get config-only behavior
- **Config contract:** ✅ uses existing agents.defaults + bundled static catalog
- **Provider contracts:** ✅ respects catalog mediaInput.image limits
- **HEIC conversion:** ✅ preserved
- **Performance:** ✅ process-stable catalog lookup
- **Side effects:** ✅ only media-understanding image paths
